name: app-glassmorphic-health-metrics-dashboard
title: Glassmorphic health metrics home with serif numerals
whatItIs: A cropped phone screen with frosted glass tiles on a blue to peach gradient. Three tiles show VO2 Max, resting heart rate and HRV with dotted sparklines and big serif numbers. A larger card gives a plain-language insight in serif type with a black arrow button, and a floating pill tab bar sits below.
whatItMeans: Calm and reassuring, like a wellness coach rather than a lab report; serif numerals give warmth and editorial character to data.
techniques: Set key numbers in a warm serif against small sans labels so data feels human.
Use dotted sparklines with a single filled end-point for a light, jewelry-like chart.
Let frosted glass tiles show a soft gradient behind so depth comes from blur, not borders.
Write the insight as a full sentence, not a metric, and give it one black circular action.
Float the nav as a translucent pill to keep the screen airy.
bestFor: Personal data dashboards aiming for calm

vocabulary.definition: UI style using translucent, blurred panels over colourful backgrounds.
A tiny word-sized line chart without axes.
A navigation bar detached from the screen edge, usually pill-shaped.
A card that interprets data in plain language.
